notes.title: Coridden is Out Now! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h3][b]We are thrilled to announce that Coridden is now available! 🥳[/b][/h3] 
This colourful aRPG is a testament to the love for gaming and will be a treat to any fan of the genre.

[h3][b]See the Launch Trailer:[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=O_mnPa8t23A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Coridden[/b] is an [b]action RPG[/b] where you play as a monster-shifter, able to [b]transform into the creatures you defeat.[/b] Venture out alone or in [b]CO-OP[/b] with [b]up to 3 friends[/b] on a journey to uncover the dark secrets sealed inside the legendary city of Aasha.

🦕 [b]BECOME A SHIFTER[/b] - Switch between your human and beast form freely to utilize each form's strengths and skills when needed.

🏹 [b]ACTION FOCUSED COMBAT[/b] - Experience intense combat action where both your own skill and character gear matters.

⚡️ [b]GROW YOUR POWERS[/b] - Build up both your human and monster form with new gear, attributes, active and passive skills as you level up.

🦹‍♂️ 🦸‍♀️ [b]RIDE OUT SOLO OR IN CO-OP[/b] - Up to 4 players can play together in drop in/drop out co-op gameplay, both locally and online. 

🏇🏻 [b]HOP ON MY BACK[/b] - Ride on each other’s back to become a strong cavalry unit together!

🌺 [b]EXPLORE THE WORLD OF HEERA[/b] - Jump, swim, use fire and break walls to access and explore everything from dangerous caves to old structures, in order to solve quests and find loot.

[b][i]"The Last Show of Mr. Chardish"[/i] is a journey through the variety of worlds created by the ingenious mind of the successful Director, Robert Chardish.[/b] Take the role of [b]Ella, the Actress[/b] and through exploring an old theatre try to unveil secrets hidden in the extraordinary, magical plays created in the imagination of Mr. Chardish.

When they were young, the Actress and the Director were full of dreams and ambitions. [b]Decades later, the Actress returns to the theatre[/b], to once more become the performer, the audience and the muse.

Virtual reality (VR) is a simulated experience that can be similar to or completely different from

notes.title: New name of the game
notes.notes:
[b]That when the dust settled and Steam Game Festival Summer Edition is already behind us, we have another news to share. We’ve changed the “Ars Fabulae” title, to "The Last Show of Mr. Chardish". And we’ve established a cooperation with an indie-focused publisher - Hydra Games! This Warsaw-based company, where you can find true game enthusiasts, is going to support us in this home stretch of development, taking care of all the publishing & marketing stuff.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35941883/d4d1d9d5221ae604c95c51544b2b5e4ce656b3ec.gif[/img]

Okay, but why actually we’ve dropped “Ars…”? Well, together with Hydra Games guys we came to the conclusion that “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish” better reflects the core of the game and the gameplay. Its story-driven approach, and the role of Robert Chardish, who is a nonplayable, but very present character, when it comes to the game’s structure and narration. Moreover, changing the title of the game is an answer to the voice of our community as well. After the Steam Game Festival, where we shared a demo version, we received a lot of questions from our followers. They asked what “Ars Fabulae” actually means and how to pronounce correctly the title. That, and some additional research, convinced us to create the new name for our beloved project. 

As you probably know (or as you can figure it out by the new title and game’s theme), we’re heavily inspired by What Remains of Edith Finch. Awed by the various gameplay mechanics and the feelings the game invoked, we decided to rise to the challenge and combine genres by designing mechanics meaningful to the story, in order to give the player something more than mere amusement.

Follow our social media (Facebook & Twitter, Steam Community Group) and add the game to the Wishlist - there are a lot of new things on the way!

Best regards,

Punk Notion & Hydra Games
